scope: Shared prospective diagnostic storage only; local scientific selections and model policy remain unchanged
retained_consumers: app/ui/intraday_models.py:load_model_research validates existing report schema and partial symbol mappings; optional status includes running
tools/intraday_model_diagnostics.py:diagnose reads explicit report symbols and previous_session; no completed status required
Operating selected-config readers use active.json; events.jsonl is no operating input
behavior: Before each compact symbol event, fsync the cumulative existing run report with running status. Event retains scalar outcome and canonical digest plus report filename and symbols/symbol path. Final full report schema/scientific results remain unchanged. Audit I/O exceptions occur outside the scientific try/except, so an already appended completed result cannot be relabelled by a later append/fsync error.
limitations: Prospective only: existing reports,events,databases,raw observations and fitted objects are untouched.
A running report is an atomic cumulative checkpoint; previously completed symbol entries and their digests remain unchanged as later symbols finish.
Checkpointing rewrites cumulative report per completed symbol and requires temporary space up to the next report size; retained full diagnostics are stored only in the existing report.

Common main lacks this composed supervisor: portable tests execute exact reviewed helper/class projections and verify both full source callsites. Local composition additionally runs existing supervisor suite.

Publication and sealed installation do not prove next nightly supervisor loading or naturally observed storage savings. No provider,model fit,trader,start,restart or maintenance operation is authorized by this patch.
Atomic checkpoint/event failures propagate as real audit errors. They preserve the completed scientific result and cannot create a contradictory second failed-symbol event after an uncertain append.
